{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Use 'status == 'completed'' as the correct definition of conversion
# because 'converted' is inconsistent with 'status' (4 cases where converted=1 but status=refunded)
converted_orders = filtered_df[filtered_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Total number of orders in the group
total_orders = len(filtered_df)

# Number of completed (converted) orders
completed_orders = len(converted_orders)

# Fraction converted
fraction_converted = completed_orders / total_orders

# Output the result
fraction_converted"}
